what: Confounds audit of the remakes decision test: properties of a candidate film that are neither its words nor its units (year, industry, membership of v2's reference corpus, length, popularity). Made by results/v2/second/audit/confounds.py. Every number unrounded. exploratory: made after the registered result was seen.
exploratory: exploratory: made after the registered result was seen

how_to_read.T: the test's statistic: the sum over families of the entries' contributions
how_to_read.Z: T divided by the root of the sum of the squared family sums
how_to_read.p: one-sided sign-flip p of the family sums, as remake_test.sign_flip_p computes it (100,000 flips, seed 20261108); known to be too small on this list
how_to_read.noise_p_registered_draws: share of the 2,000 registered pure-noise draws (remakes_null_size.json, 39 columns) with Z at or above this Z, the observed one counted as a draw
how_to_read.noise_p_own_draws: the same share among 300 pure-noise draws put through this analysis's own word model and pools
how_to_read.gain: held-out log-likelihood of the true sources with the unit column added to the word model, minus without it
how_to_read.effective_pairs_left_open: sum over entries of one minus the held-out word probability of the true source
how_to_read.condition_5: not re-evaluated: the stand-in panel was not rebuilt (machine rule); the registered largest stand-in Z, 2.228, belongs to the baseline's word model and pools only

notes: The list of analyses in the script's docstring was written before any of them was run. Before the real run the code was tried once on every sixth entry (37 entries) with random numbers in the units' place (AUDIT_DRY=1); that trial showed no unit result, but it did show the descriptions (a) and the property probes (P) on that sixth, which use no unit. Nothing was changed after it except a guard against a division by zero.
The stand-in panel was not rebuilt, the every-film frame and the secondary sets were not analysed (machine rules).
A second round (G, S, R: see second_round) was added after the first round's results were seen; the first round's blocks were not run again.

Data: the film table gives 'Vettai (film)', the source of Tadakha (2013), the year 1986. The same plot stands in the table a second time under the page 'Vettai' with the year 2012, and the corpus kept the row dated 1986. So that pair's year gap here is 27 years where the film's is 1: D1a and D1b drop the entry, D1c and D6 give it a pool of films of 1981 to 1991, and in the registered frame the film is a candidate for remakes of 1986 to 2011 that it could not have been the source of. Its contribution to the baseline T (Qwen3-32B): 1.729.
